summary: Version the shared sidebar behavior fixtures and preserve the legacy projection, move and rollup cases.

replay.detail: No daemon event replay or stored state changes.

schema.detail: No database schema change. The new JSON Schema versions test fixtures independently of arrangement bodies.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Sidebar test consumers use fixtures/clients/sidebar/behavior-v1.json and its schema instead of sidebar-v2.json. Both existing runners are migrated; runtime client and wire contracts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Test-fixture-only change; no service interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator steps. Repository fixture consumers are updated together.

recovery.detail: Revert the fixture and runner changes together if needed; no data migration or state recovery is required.
